name: TrustGate AI
description: Fail-closed identity verification and deterministic payment-intent policy review for autonomous agents. The service checks CIS-8004 Concordium badge verification results, validates recipient allowlists and request limits, then returns an explainable ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK decision. Prototype only: no autonomous wallet signing, transfers or x402 payment execution.

skills.name: Verify agent identity
skills.description: Check a Concordium CIS-8004 agent badge through the official server-side registry endpoint before evaluating intents.

skills.name: Evaluate payment intent
skills.description: Deterministically return ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK according to identity verification, allowlisted recipient, purpose and per-request USD amount; no payment is executed.
